أهتجر (form VIII)
# أَهْتَجِرُ (ʔahtajiru) /ʔah.ta.d͡ʒi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
# أَهْتَجِرَ (ʔahtajira) /ʔah.ta.d͡ʒi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
# أَهْتَجِرْ (ʔahtajir) /ʔah.ta.d͡ʒir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
